svg.title: 60-on-demand-paused-clock-hindsight-dropped-frames
svg.text: The whole run: 8.0 s, 393 presented frames on a 60 Hz display, measured against a 16.7 ms target.
Resolution 16.7 ms (one capture period); error threshold 1 ms.
Frame rates and display time steps excluding 8 static frames: nothing animates while they are on screen.
ANIMATION ERROR PER FRAME: + SHOWN TOO SOON, − SHOWN TOO LATE
■ within the error threshold ■ static: nothing animates
DISPLAY TIME STEP: HOW LONG EACH FRAME STAYED ON SCREEN
━ as planned ━ held: frames never shown before the next ■ static: nothing animates
FRAMETIME AND CPU BUSY: THE APPLICATION SIDE, FROM THE MARKERS
━ frametime: CPU start to the next ■ CPU busy: until presented ■ static: nothing animates
SHARE OF LATE FRAMES IN THE LAST 2 S (WHOLE RUN 0.0 %)
REFRESH STRIP: ONE CELL PER REFRESH, A NEW SHADE PER FRAME
▐▌ static ■ a dropped frame was due (repeat)
EVENTS: WHAT THE FRAMES DID, WHAT THE CAPTURE MISSED
